proposals.evidence: Turner tuṇḍa section 3 *tōṇḍa explicitly gives Marathi tõḍ and Konkani toṃḍa mouth; section 7 records initial retroflex variants, and the introduction discusses internal dental-to-retroflex assimilation. These regional o-vowel mouth forms are compared with that family. The existing canonical node is the unsplit 5853; no nonexistent section node is invented, and source-internal spacing is retained.

proposals.evidence: Turner manas supplies the regional man mind family. Platts explicitly derives Hindi man from Prakrit maṇo and Sanskrit manas and includes heart among its senses. The surveyed man/mon forms are compared with this family; their elicited heart sense is preserved, without claiming that all varieties distinguish anatomical and emotional senses identically.
